The '''Antilles family''' was dedicated to governmental service. Its members included [[Bail Antilles (Galactic Alliance)|Bail Antilles]], a one-time member of the [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]],<ref name="LECG ">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and his daughter, [[Ona Antilles]].<ref name="Legacy 42" />
